text:
maya: Quick sync — SDK PR landed needs API change merged before console can green.
aj: which PRs exactly? link?
maya: SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1987 — bumps wire schema for batch endpoint
maya: API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2564 — small adapter to accept new batch header
kevin: console failing because it calls /v1/batch with old header name, tests 4/5 are red
sophie: I can update console client but need API merged first otherwise CI will fail on integration
aj: order of ops: api -> sdk -> console, or can we gate with feature flag?
maya: API change is backwards compatible for one release if we keep parsing both headers, but we prefer cleaning up quickly
kevin: PR for console ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/842 — just needs API to be merged and a quick rebase
aj: who's the approver for API? @kevin? (assigning in GH now)
kevin: I can review today, will do a pass around noon UTC
sophie: tagging e2e owner @maya — once API and SDK are merged i'll run the console e2e locally and report
dev-bot: CI status: api/pr-2564 — checks: unit ✅, integration ❌ (currently pending external service mock)
maya: integration failure is unrelated (flaky mock). I restarted the job: https://ci.redwood/status/2564
deploy-bot: NOTE: If these merge order changes affect helm chart, please open a follow-up. runtime image tags must align.
maya: good call — I opened helm ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/issues/412 to coordinate image/tag update if needed
aj: plan: kevin merges API after review, maya merges SDK next (small rebase), kevin merges console last and runs canary on staging. If staging ok, merge to main for a deploy window tonight 22:00 PT.
kevin: ack, will review in next 2 hours. If anything blocks, ping me in this thread.
sophie: I'll stand by for rebase, and will run the staged canary smoke tests (chat+embeddings flow)
maya: thanks — marking this P0 for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:
aj: adding a short checklist in the GH PR comments for merge order and required approvals.
kevin: one more: ensure helm values default to old behavior until canary completes — don't flip globally.
maya: noted, adding feature flag and default true for backwards compatible path.
aj: great. We'll reconvene in-thread for any blockers. :rocket:
